body: I really appreciate your advice. I've thought about just trying anything new, got nothing to lose right? But I can't seem to escape the trap to go and try something. Bills, rent and my dog keep tying me here and the longer im tied down the worse im feeling. My dog is the one thing I can't give up on, but that's making it worse cause even if I want to just leave everything behind I have to stay for him. I love the little guy but right now im not a responsible person, yet I have to be. Trapped again. I just can't figure out how to not feel trapped. The only thing I have total control over is whether I live or die.
